text: Valerie Amezcua ran for Mayor four years ago with the promise to listen to Santa Ana residents and work hard every day to improve and protect the quality of life in our neighborhoods.

As our Mayor, Valerie’s delivered on her promises and successfully worked to:
Combat crime, improve 911 response times, and strengthen police oversight.
Enhance parks and expand safe routes to school programs. Reduce homelessness by focusing on mental health and housing. Help Santa Ana businesses grow and create family-wage jobs. Re-open the Newhope Library and open the new Delhi Library. Repair streets and clean up blighted properties.
Ensure transparency at City Hall and responsibly manage tax dollars.

Prior to her election as Mayor, Valerie served two terms on the Santa Ana Unified School Board where she improved graduation rates and opened Wellness Centers at all 56 of our neighborhood schools. She’s a mom and grandmother who worked for 30 years as a Supervising Probation Officer in Orange County.
“Santa Ana residents deserve a Mayor who will listen to them and work hard to deliver results at City Hall. I hope to earn your vote and continue serving our city.”

Learn more @ www.ValerieAmezcua.com
Contact directly@ valamezcua@yahoo.com

text: I'm running for Mayor because Santa Ana is my home, and I believe in the strength, resilience, and heart of our community.

As an attorney, I advocate for the rights of others and understand that lasting solutions begin with listening. I will fight for your voice and lead with integrity, accountability, and transparency. Working together, we can strengthen our local economy, support small businesses, improve access to affordable housing, and create more opportunities for families to succeed and thrive. I will stand with you and ensure your voice is heard.

Recently, I have felt the fear and uncertainty affecting many members of our community — including my own family — during ICE raids and other immigration enforcement. No one should have to live in fear or feel disconnected from the city they call home. As Mayor, I will work to build a local government that is compassionate, accessible, and worthy of the public’s trust — where every resident is treated with dignity and respect.

Together, we can strengthen public participation in government and foster an environment where every resident feels proud to call Santa Ana home. I would be honored to earn your trust and your vote. I will always have your back.

text: As a Community Development Commissioner, caregiver, and community organizer, I am running for Mayor because I believe Santa Ana deserves leadership that listen, leads with integrity, and puts residents first. Our city is filled with hardworking families, thriving businesses, and young people who deserve every opportunity to succeed.

Through years of community service, I have worked alongside residents to strengthen our neighborhoods, support local businesses, mentor youth, and bring people together through action – not just words. I believe leadership begins by showing up, listening, and finding practical solutions that improve everyday life.

As Mayor, I will prioritize public safety, economic growth, neighborhood revitalization, government transparency, and practical solutions to homelessness while investing in opportunities for our youth, seniors, and working families. My goal is to build a cleaner, safer, and more united Santa Ana where every resident has the opportunity to thrive.

I love this city because it is my home, and I believe our greatest days are still ahead. Together, we can move Santa Ana forward with leadership that is accountable, compassionate, and committed to every neighborhood. I respectfully ask for your vote and the opportunity to serve as your next Mayor and work alongside every resident every day.
